Built a complete, playable **Fruit Force** arcade shooter in `index.html`.

- Fly around and shoot incoming fruit, dodge projectiles, collect juice power-ups, and unleash a screen-clearing blast.
- Includes escalating sectors, score and best-score tracking, lives, pause/resume, and a game-over screen.
- Supports keyboard controls and mobile touch controls.
- Uses original canvas-drawn visuals; no game assets or build setup required.

**Controls:** WASD or arrow keys to move, Space to fire, X to blast, P or Esc to pause. On mobile, use the joystick and action buttons.

Verified JavaScript syntax and checked the game in a browser at desktop and mobile sizes; no browser-console errors.
